M14.known_limit: Historical function cursor and individual ABI/compiled/source-body receipts do not establish complete semantic replacement coverage or an original-line weighting. Retained C boundaries often already have Rust bodies.

M15.bounded_finding: Existing selected-default and actual HOST qualification proof identifies no specific missing supported-profile Rust body. This is not an exhaustive semantic equivalence claim or evidence of zero net debt.
selection_evidence: Current executer/user/CMakeLists removes mcexec.c in its qualified x86_64 Rust default and selects Rust BFD accessors.
Current IHK CMake selects the all-Rust whole70 library and Rust CLIs/supervisor under its exact supported-profile guards.
Existing genuine HOST links, 70 function/six data roots and diagnostic/supervisor consumers are retained; complete behavior/deployed/native qualification is still open.

implementation_metric_is_separate_from_a: A complete source/function map could measure implementation debt before native acceptance. Open acceptance gates do not make every retained C line unconverted, and selected Rust roots do not by themselves prove every original body has a complete replacement.
requested_metric: Nonblank/noncomment original C body lines that still lack a complete Rust replacement, separately from retained C reference/fallback lines.
scope: Bounded owner assessment using existing maps/selection/qualification proof; no census, compiler, new framework or M15 implementation.
source_retirement_audit_limitation: The audit explicitly tracks source retirement, not functional helper ownership; file/tracker/build ownership is not the requested body conversion metric.
